name: Hardware Corner: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16GB, llama.cpp CUDA, Qwen3 14B Q4_K XL GGUF, pp512 2003.44 t/s @16k ctx
unit: tok/s per-request prompt processing pp512 (batch 1, ~16384-token context)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (hardware-corner.net Definitive GPU Ranking for LLMs, page updated 2025-12-09, accessed 2026-10-16). llama.cpp llama-bench on Ubuntu 24.04, CUDA 12.8, Q4_K_XL GGUF (nearest repo format gguf-q4-k-m), single GPU, full offload. Metric is per-request prompt-processing tok/s (pp512) measured with the context filled to ~16384 tokens (16k), batch 1, NOT aggregate. Value is the 16k column of the prompt-processing table for Qwen3 14B.
notes: Single-GPU batch-1 row from the Hardware Corner in-lab ranking table. Q4_K_XL is their published quant label; filed under gguf-q4-k-m as the nearest schema format, same convention as the 16k rows already in this repo. Per-request, not an aggregate serving number. The page does not publish the exact llama.cpp commit hash for this table.
